family: Normalized rational real two-dimensional fiber vectors (analytic uncertainty lemma for all vectors, subsequently applied to actual Boolean spectra)
parameter_domain: Rotation t in {1/4,1/8,1/16}, p=(2t/(1+t^2))^2; unit-vector stereographic parameter s in {-4,-3,-2,-1,-1/2,-1/4,0,1/4,1/2,1,2,3,4}
arithmetic: Fraction exact squared amplitudes; entropy inequality is analytic, no numerical logarithms
purpose: Check exact lower sum of minority masses >=1-sqrt(1-p); proof handles all normalized fibers and all finite Boolean functions
